nodes.label: Historically Anchored Interior Cutaway Grammar
nodes.rationale: The interior research uses museum and vernacular-house sources to define full-screen front-wall-removed notebook cutaways with the exterior's low-oblique camera, stable door/sprite scale, walkable floor, fitted doors, and historically plausible domestic or shop furnishings.

nodes.label: Murphy C and Connolly C Gameplay-Fit Targets
nodes.rationale: Murphy Farm C and Connolly Shop C are the recommended concept targets because they widen playable capacity and preserve same-sprite-scale interaction affordances, while remaining concept art rather than runtime-ready plates.
